jobs.prompt: T-0315 (S10, R-079): write tools/watch-assets/cc-phone.css, phone-width (390px) responsive styling for the command-center mockup (read docs/design/command-center-mockup/hive.html and docs/design/command-center-mockup/shared.css as context for the existing markup/class names and design tokens - this new stylesheet should target those same classes/structure, not invent new markup). Write tests/command-center-phone.spec.mjs as a Playwright test (check for an existing pattern/config first; if none exists, write it as Playwright and say plainly if the runner isn't installed rather than claiming a run that didn't happen) that loads hive.html at a 390px viewport and asserts each of the 5 acceptance points programmatically. No Docker needed. Keep this focused and move quickly - write the CSS first, then the test; do not over-polish.
